about: Words that must not appear in a public file of the hypersvg export. release/verify.mjs reads this file from the export and refuses any file, or file name, that matches a pattern, unless an allow entry covers the match. It names the file, the line and the reason. This file is the only one it does not scan, because it lists the words. Private PC paths and secrets are refused by release/scan.mjs as before.
